credentials.description: TokenHub API key for chat and Kling video. Required for TokenHub requests unless passed in settings.
Tencent Cloud secret ID for VOD video. Required for VOD requests unless passed in settings.
Tencent Cloud secret key for VOD video. Required for VOD requests unless passed in settings.
VOD SubAppId (positive integer). Required for VOD requests unless passed in settings.
Optional temporary-credential session token for VOD.

notes: Tencent TokenHub chat models and Kling video generation, plus Tencent Cloud VOD video generation with TC3-signed requests. Both backends expose resumable video jobs, and each backend loads its own credentials only when used.
